title: Grants accepted by vote, and grants accepted under standing authority
question: How much of the grant money the City takes in is accepted by a Board resolution of its own, and what does the new $1 million line remove?
finding: The Board passed 671 accept-and-expend files from fiscal 2019 to 2026, naming $3.56 billion. In fiscal 2024 they named $437.6 million, against the $2.81 billion in grants and contributions the Board’s analyst counted in City revenue that year (16%): the rest came in through the annual budget, or to the transit agency, whose grants need no Board approval. Ordinance 135-26, passed on 23 July 2026, raises the line for a separate vote from $100,000 to $1,000,000 from October 1, 2026. 284 of the 671 files since 2019 (42%) were for less than $1,000,000 and would no longer come to the Board; they hold $108.9 million, 3.1% of the dollars.
how: Board files flagged as accept-and-expend in the project’s table of Board money files, passed, counted in the fiscal year passed, with the dollar figure parsed from the title. The old and new lines and the start date are read from the title of the ordinance that changed them. Citywide grant revenue for fiscal 2023-24, and the two routes that need no separate resolution, are from the Budget and Legislative Analyst’s report of 28 January 2025.
limits: A grant taken in through the annual budget has been voted on, as one line of a very large ordinance, and the analyst reports standard controls for adding grant revenue to the budget. Raising the line trades many small votes for a rule: the ordinance lets the Controller set rules for grants below it. The fiscal 2024 comparison sets one year’s resolutions against one year’s revenue, and a multi-year grant is voted once and received over several years, so the share is indicative only. The records on disk do not list the grants that were accepted without a resolution, so they cannot be named or counted. What would supply that: the Controller’s grant ledger by grant and approval route. Amounts, parties and dates taken from Board file titles are read by machine: in a hand check of 50 titles, 11 had at least one field read wrongly (4 after later fixes).
